SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8019
Section 1, Special Branch 37
REPORT
Date July 21, 1937.

Subject Mr. Charles Frederick Livesey.

Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by C. Sanford. D. I.

Regarding the attached request for information about
Mr. C.F. Livesey and Mrs. Marie Olsen: Mr. Charles Federick
Livesey, British subject, was born in Hongkong on 7th November,
1885, of British parents. He received his schooling in
Hongkong, and at the age of 15 was apprenticed to the
Cosmopolitan Docks where he worked for five years. In 1912
Mr. Livesey married Miss Lucy Young, a Chinese Eurasian born
in Foochow on 3rd April, 1888, by whom he had three children
namely Harriet Lucy (born on 28.12.1912), Edward George
(born on 28.5.1914) and John (born on 17.2.1916). In 1915
he proceeded to England and worked in the Woolwich Arsenal
Munitions Factory for one year, after which he was employed in
the Mercantile Marine Service for a further year. From this
time onwards he was employed as follows:-
4th Engineer S.S. "Gallia", 6th March to 5th June, 1919.
3rd Engineer S.S. "Roumelian", 28th August to 9th November, 1920.
He returned to Hongkong in 1923 where he was employed
by the Chung Wha Navigation Company in the s.s. "Lingnam" as
3rd Engineer from 7th September 1923 to 23rd July 1924. He
was next employed as 4th Engineer on the s.s. "Strathlorne"
(Burrell & Sons, Glasgow) from 21st September 1924 until his
discharge from this boat in Hull, England, on 24th December
1924.
He came to Shanghai in May 1925 with his wife and family,
and obtained work for a short time with the Shanghai Waterworks.
On 20th September 1926 he was engaged by the S.M.C. Electricity
Department as a coal checker in which capacity he continued to
work with the Shanghai Power Company until 1st May 1937, on
which date he proceeded on long leave on the understanding that*

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 8019
特务科第 37 组，第 1 部分
报告
日期：1937年7月21日。

事由：查尔斯·弗雷德里克·利夫西（Charles Frederick Livesey）先生。

制作人：副督察劳里尔（Laurier） 转呈人：首席督察 C. 桑福德（C. Sanford）。

关于所附查询查尔斯·F·利夫西先生及玛丽·奥尔森夫人（Mrs. Marie Olsen）信息的请求：查尔斯·弗雷德里克·利夫西，英国籍，父母均为英国人，于1885年11月7日出生于香港。他在香港接受教育，15岁时在环球码头（Cosmopolitan Docks）当学徒，工作了五年。1912年，利夫西先生与露西·杨小姐（Miss Lucy Young）结婚，杨小姐为中英混血儿，1888年4月3日出生于福州，婚后育有三名子女，分别为：哈丽特·露西（Harriet Lucy，生于1912年12月28日）、爱德华·乔治（Edward George，生于1914年5月28日）和约翰（John，生于1916年2月17日）。1915年，他前往英国，在伍尔维奇兵工厂军火厂（Woolwich Arsenal Munitions Factory）工作了一年，随后又在商船队服务了一年。此后，他的受雇情况如下：
1919年3月4日至6月5日，任“高卢号”（S.S. "Gallia"）轮船四管轮。
1920年8月28日至11月9日，任“鲁梅利安号”（S.S. "Roumelian"）轮船三管轮。
他于1923年返回香港，自1923年9月7日至1924年7月23日，受雇于中华轮船公司（Chung Wha Navigation Company），在“岭南号”（s.s. "Lingnam"）轮船上担任三管轮。随后，他自1924年9月21日起，受雇于（格拉斯哥伯雷尔父子公司 Burrell & Sons, Glasgow 所属的）“斯特拉斯洛恩号”（s.s. "Strathlorne"）轮船担任四管轮，直至1924年12月24日在英国赫尔港（Hull）离职。
他于1925年5月携妻眷来到上海，并在上海自来水公司短暂工作。1926年9月20日，他被工部局电气处聘为验煤员，并以此身份在上海电力公司工作至1937年5月1日，当日他请长假，约定*

his service with the Power Company would terminate on expiration
of his leave. He left Shanghai for Japan in the "Shanghai Maru"
on May 6th accompanied by a woman named Mrs. Marie Olsen.
For many years past Mr. Livesey has neglected his wife
and children, living away from home and associating with and
supporting women of indifferent moral character whilst the
members of his family were left to fend for themselves. Mrs.
Livesey is destitute and now lives at the Foreign Women's Home.
One son is in the British Army whilst the daughter, Harriet, who
is shortly to be married for the second time, was, soon after
her arrival from Hongkong with her parents, forced upon the
charity of the Foreign Women's Home as her father would neither
care for nor support her financially.
Mr. Livesey suffers from some physical ailment which
resulted in his resignation from the Shanghai Power Company.
（批：Omit）and he seems to be as frail morally as he is physically. Apart
from this, however, There is nothing of a criminal or political
nature regarding him in Police records. He last resided in
Shanghai at House 3, Lane 360 Avenue du Roi Albert with Mrs.
Marie Olsen, the woman with whom he has associated for some time
past and who accompanied him to Japan on 6th May 1937.
Mrs. Marie Olsen, now a widow, was born in Kursk, Russia,
on 15th June 1895, and became a Danish subject upon her marriage.
She first registered with the Danish Consulate in Shanghai in
1929. There is nothing in Police or Consular records to her
detriment.

A. Laurier.
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch) 2/7

其在该电力公司的服务将在假期届满时终止。他于5月6日乘坐“上海丸”轮离开上海前往日本，随行女子名为玛丽·奥尔森夫人。
多年来，利夫西先生一直疏于照顾妻儿，离家在外，与品行不端的女子交往并供养她们，而其家人则不得不自谋生路。利夫西夫人生活贫困，现居住于外侨妇女收容所（Foreign Women's Home）。其一子目前在英军服役；其女哈丽特即将第二次结婚，她在随父母从香港抵达后不久，因父亲既不愿照顾也不愿提供经济支持，被迫依靠外侨妇女收容所的慈善救济生活。
利夫西先生患有某种身体疾病，这导致他从上海电力公司辞职。
（批：删除）且他在道德上的软弱似乎与其身体上的虚弱相当。除此之外，警方记录中没有任何关于他的刑事或政治性质的内容。他在上海最后的住址是阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）360弄3号，与他同居一段时间并陪同他于1937年5月6日前往日本的女子玛丽·奥尔森夫人同住。
玛丽·奥尔森夫人现为寡妇，1895年6月15日出生于俄罗斯库尔斯克（Kursk），婚后取得丹麦国籍。她于1929年首次在上海丹麦领事馆登记。警方或领事馆记录中没有任何对她不利的记载。

A. 劳里尔

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No....................
S. 1. Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
Date July 2, 1937.

Subject (in full) Police assistance requested by the local Japanese
Consular Police.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J Boyne D.S.S

Chancellr of the 3rd Section
Mr. Hashizume of the local Japanese Consular Police
states that he would be much obliged if the Municipal Police
would furnish him with information regarding the antecedents
of Charle Frederick Livesey and his paramour, Marie Olsen,
who formerly resided at No. 360 Av. du Roi Albert .

It is reported that Charle Frederick Livesey, a British
subject, born on November 7, 1885, was formerly in the employ
of the Shanghai Power Company as an engineer and resigned
from that firm in April of this year on account of his ill-
health. He arrived in Beppu, Japan, in company with Marie
Olsen, a Dane, 42 years of age, on May 9, 1937, since which
date they have been residing in Beppu.

D. S. Kamashita
D. S.

S/

D. C. (Special Branch).

（印：- 2 JULY 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

DSS Laurier

报告
日期：1937年7月2日。

事由（全称）：当地日本领事警察请求警务协助。

制作人：副督察桥下（Kamashita） 转呈人：J·博伊恩（J Boyne） 副助理总监

日本领事警察第三科科长
当地日本领事警察的桥爪（Hashizume）先生表示，如果工部局警务处能提供有关查尔斯·弗雷德里克·利夫西及其情妇玛丽·奥尔森的背景信息，他将不胜感激，二人此前居住在阿尔贝国王路360号。

据报，查尔斯·弗雷德里克·利夫西，英国籍，生于1885年11月7日，此前受雇于上海电力公司担任工程师，今年四月因健康原因从该公司辞职。他于1937年5月9日与42岁的丹麦人玛丽·奥尔森一同抵达日本别府，自此一直居住在别府。

D. S. 桥下
副督察

S/

特务科副主任。
